footprint_format: KiCad upstream20260206; EasyEDA converter may need downlevel normalization by PCB exporter

notes: Preserve twelve plated through-hole pad41 vias with 0.20mm drills and the central SMD pad41. All thirteen pad41 instances are GND; no NPTH features occur in this footprint. Antenna keepout must prohibit copper, tracks and components on every layer, not only F.Cu. Keep antenna at board edge and no battery/display metal nearby.
issues: Antenna module placement and 15mm case/battery clearance require mechanical review.

notes: TI datasheet pages26/27 reviewed visually: body1.0x0.8,height0.50max, three0.30x0.30mm lands;0.70mm lower-pad pitch and0.85mm upper/lower land center separation.
issues: TI datasheet and official KiCad footprint specify a 1.0x0.8mm DRT body with 0.50mm maximum height. Source package prose is corrected. Before manufacture verify the purchased package revision and assembler stencil rules.

notes: Upstream KiCad9 is rear detection terminal B; KiCad10 is side detection terminal A. Supplied custom footprint renames physical pads to A/B matching the schematic. A at (-6.825,2.775) mm; B at (-5.875,-7.725) mm; retain four shell pads named SH. Dry switch closes A-B on insertion. Retain all four copper keepouts and front card-ejection drawing.
issues: Pad naming was translated from Hirose catalog labels and official KiCad geometry. Before fabrication, independently compare the purchased socket drawing and verify detector contacts with continuity. Detector A/B are nonpolar; reversed A/B wiring retains function, but detector must never be assumed to be shell.

notes: 8 contacts,2.0mm pitch,0.75mm plated drills. Pin1 square. Harness follows Waveshare MODULE J2 numbering; check actual cable continuity because Waveshare header J1 is reversed.
